sources.citation: real-world: 3/4 trade size steel EMT, outside diameter 0.922 in = 23.42 mm, nominal wall 0.049 in = 1.24 mm; steel-EMT makers’ published dimension tables for ANSI C80.3 / UL 797 tubing (cited by number), read 2026-11-12. No NEC Chapter 9 table is used. The body box rounds the diameter up to 24 mm (even, so the ends sit on whole millimetres).

real-world (product data): makers’ standard 90° steel EMT elbows for ANSI C80.3 / UL 797 tubing (cited by number) have a 114 mm centreline radius (4.50 in) and straight legs of 64 mm (2.5 in) at each end (makers’ elbow sheets, read 2026-11-12; a second maker gives 5.80 in for 1 in). Product data, not a code table of minimum bend radii; bends are not checked in P3.
game-design: the elbow’s box is its leg plus its bend radius plus half its body diameter, square; its ends are on the box’s faces so joined parts touch.
